annotation.title_clean: Ethical guide to development and deployment of robots
annotation.title_en: Ethical guide to development and deployment of robots
annotation.venue: ICRES 2022: 7th International Conference on Robot Ethics and Standards, Seoul
annotation.summary_en: Short conference abstract describing BS 8611:2016, the first ethical standard for robots, and its ongoing revision. The revision adds ethical risk assessment based on ISO 12100, design-oriented ethical guidelines, and verification and validation. It stresses that standards are voluntary but advantageous to adopt.
key_provisions_or_claims: BS 8611:2016 was the first ethical robot design standard worldwide.
The revision adopts the ISO 12100 risk assessment approach for ethical risks (societal, application, commercial, environmental).
Ethical hazards such as privacy, dignity, human rights and cultural diversity are translated into design parameters.
Verification and validation will cover testing and formal methods.
Standards are voluntary, but compliance benefits manufacturers.
